items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. One flat-rate charge is estimated at €81 gross.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers sealing material needed for the pipe repair. One unit is estimated at €26 gross.

Section 2.4.3(a) covers internal supply-pipe fracture, and sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 limit replacement to the pre-loss specification. One metre is estimated at €40 gross, assuming the pipe failure was a fracture and the replacement is like-for-like.
Section 7.1.7(c) covers replacement of the pre-existing insulation disturbed by the repair. One metre is estimated at €23 gross.

Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour, but section 7.1.8(c) bars overlap with the technician charge. If this is a distinct hour, the comparable plumbing installation in Case 39 supports €80 gross rather than the flat-job AC installation benchmark.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers reasonable technician time for access and repair. Treating the nine labour units as hours, the comparable bathroom repair in Case 39 supports about €765 gross at €85 per hour.
Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover necessary drying and allow one flat-rate deployment charge per drying operation. The single charge is estimated at €548 gross.

items.description: Close and repaint the wall patch
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(a) cover making good the access opening and restoring the affected patch. The combined local repair is estimated at €588 gross, without any allowance for repainting beyond the patch.

Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude repainting the undamaged remainder because the original paint was still available; line 8 already covers the patch. If separately payable, the eight-square-metre repaint would be about €160 gross at €20 per square metre.
Sections 7.1.5–7.1.6 exclude work on separate, undamaged surfaces done only to match. The conditional estimate for the bundled repaint is €420 gross; no payment is expected.
